marketing.terms-1-body: By creating an account you agree to these terms. If you use the service on behalf of a company, you confirm you are authorised to accept them for it. The service is provided by MedChina Gestão e Prontuários, CNPJ 38.504.491/0001-80, Goiânia (GO), Brazil, reachable at contato@medchinaprontuarios.com.br.
marketing.terms-2-body: You are responsible for the activity in your organization's account and for keeping credentials safe. Usage must comply with applicable law; abuse, unauthorized access attempts and resale without agreement are prohibited.
marketing.terms-3-body: Paid plans renew automatically for the chosen period and can be cancelled at any time from the billing page, keeping access until the end of the paid period. Price changes are announced in advance and never apply retroactively.
marketing.terms-4-body: The service is provided as described, with reasonable commercial efforts to keep it available. Either party may terminate the agreement; on termination you can export your data, and records required by law remain retained as described in the privacy policy.
marketing.privacy-1-body: The platform is operated by MedChina Gestão e Prontuários, CNPJ 38.504.491/0001-80, Goiânia (GO), Brazil. To ask about privacy or to request access, correction or deletion, write to contato@medchinaprontuarios.com.br; the same channel answers as data protection officer. This policy covers the data of the professional who subscribes, the clinical data she records about her patients and the data of people who register for our events.
marketing.privacy-2-title: Two different roles: yours and ours
marketing.privacy-2-body: Your patients' data is yours. You are its controller and decide why and how it is processed; MedChina acts as processor and handles that data only to provide the service, following your instructions. Your own account data, such as registration, billing and platform usage, is processed by us as controller, to keep the service running, to charge for it and to meet legal obligations. This split follows Brazilian law 13.709/2018, the LGPD.
marketing.privacy-3-body: From the professional: name, e-mail, phone, encrypted password, professional registration and title when provided, tax id and billing details, plus technical records such as IP address, browser, device and access times. From patients, entered or dictated by you: identification, clinical history, intake, progress notes, treatment plans, issued documents and, when a consultation is recorded, the audio and its transcript. We do not collect patient data by other means and do not use it for any other purpose. From people who register for one of our events: name, WhatsApp, e-mail when provided, the link or ad that led to the registration and their participation in the event, such as joining the announcement group, attendance and time watched.
marketing.privacy-4-title: Why we process it, and on what legal basis
marketing.privacy-4-body: Performance of the contract: creating and keeping your account, storing records, issuing documents, processing payments and providing support. Legal obligation: keeping tax records and responding to authorities. Legitimate interest: platform security, fraud prevention, service improvement and measurement of our own marketing campaigns. Consent: recording the consultation and preparing the intake with artificial intelligence, authorised by the patient inside the platform, per purpose, with the date and version of the term. Health data is processed for health care by the professional, under article 11 of the LGPD. For people who register for an event: consent, recorded with the date and version of the term, to send the link, reminders and recording by WhatsApp and, if provided, by e-mail; and a second, optional and separate consent to receive news and to have the contact used in ad audiences. Registering for the event never depends on the second.
marketing.cookies-1-body: Cookies are small files kept in your browser. We use cookies on the public site and in the signed-in area, each group for the purpose described below. This policy complements the Privacy Policy.
marketing.cookies-2-body: They keep you signed in, protect the platform against fraud, store language and theme preferences and remember where a visit came from and a campaign code. The service does not work without them, so they do not depend on authorisation.
marketing.cookies-3-body: On the public site we load the Meta Pixel and Google Analytics, which write the _fbp, _fbc and _ga cookies to measure visits and campaign results. You can refuse them in the cookie notice: the scripts stop loading and we store only your refusal. None of them runs inside the clinical area.
marketing.cookie-consent-description: We use essential cookies plus analytics and ad cookies, which you can refuse. Measurement of our own sales runs on our server, under legitimate interest.
marketing.privacy-5-body: Recording is optional, and each purpose has its own authorisation: recording is one, preparing the intake with AI is another. Without a recorded consent, recording does not start. Audio and text are processed by AI providers we contract, to transcribe, organise and prepare hypotheses that require your review; nothing is finalised without you, and whatever was not said stays blank. Clinical content is not used to train third-party models, and the audio can be deleted once the transcript is validated.
marketing.privacy-6-body: Only with vendors needed to run the service, under contract and with limited access: Supabase (database, authentication and files), Vercel (hosting), Asaas and Stripe (payments), Resend (system e-mail), Inngest (background processing), Google and Anthropic (transcription and artificial intelligence), Meta and Google Analytics, on the public site only (campaign measurement), and WhatsApp, owned by Meta, which hosts the announcement group of our events without showing each participant's number to the others. Meta also receives the contact details of people who registered for an event, converted into an irreversible code, to build ad audiences, but only when the person authorised this in the optional news consent. Some of these vendors process data outside Brazil; in those cases we require contractual safeguards with protection equivalent to the LGPD. We do not sell personal data.
marketing.privacy-7-body: On the public site we use analytics and ad-measurement cookies from Meta and Google Analytics, which you can refuse in the cookie notice at any time. Measurement of our own sales runs on our server and keeps working after a refusal, because it does not depend on those cookies: we send Meta and Google only commercial data about the subscriber, such as an e-mail turned into an irreversible code, the account identifier, IP address, browser and purchase value, on the legitimate interest of measuring and funding the promotion of the service. No patient data and no clinical data is sent, and none of these tools runs inside the clinical area. Registering for an event creates a sign-up event in the browser, subject to the same cookie refusal. The list of registrations is only sent to Meta as an ad audience for people who ticked the optional news consent, and phone and e-mail are sent as an irreversible code. To object to this processing, write to contato@medchinaprontuarios.com.br. Details are in the Cookie Policy.
marketing.privacy-8-body: Account data and records stay while the account exists. Consultation audio follows the retention policy you choose and can be deleted once the transcript is validated. After the account closes we keep only what legal obligations and the exercise of rights require, and delete the rest. A full export of your data is available at any time, with or without an active plan. Data of people who register for an event is deleted six months after the last event they registered for, unless they agreed to receive news; in that case it is kept until they withdraw that consent.
marketing.privacy-9-body: Each workspace is isolated in the database itself, traffic is encrypted, access is limited by role and two-factor authentication is available. We keep an access log and a change history of clinical records. In an incident with relevant risk we notify the Brazilian data protection authority and the people affected within a reasonable time, describing the nature of the data involved, the risks and the measures taken.
marketing.privacy-10-title: Your rights and your patients' rights
marketing.privacy-10-body: You may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, portability, anonymisation, deletion, information about sharing, withdrawal of consent and review of decisions, in the app or through our contact channel. When the request comes from a patient, you answer it as controller; we provide the technical support and act on your instructions. Any data subject may also complain to the Brazilian data protection authority. Anyone who registered for an event can leave at any time by replying SAIR on WhatsApp, through the unsubscribe link in our e-mails or through our contact channel.
marketing.privacy-11-body: If this policy changes materially we announce it on the site and in the cookie notice, and the date above changes with it. Previous versions are available on request through our contact channel.
marketing.cookies-4-body: Beyond cookies, we send Meta and Google, from our server, the events of our own sales: sign-up, subscription start and payment. They carry commercial data about the subscriber, such as an e-mail turned into an irreversible code, the account identifier, IP address, browser and value, never patient data. This relies on the legitimate interest of measuring the promotion of the service and continues even if you refuse analytics cookies, because it does not depend on them. To object, write to contato@medchinaprontuarios.com.br.
marketing.cookies-5-body: You can refuse analytics in the site notice, delete cookies in your browser settings or browse in a private window. Blocking essential cookies prevents sign-in and use of the platform.
